ANJ.name: Anjanapura Township
ANJ.ask: 99acres avg Rs 13,500-13,750/ft² (range 12-15k); NoBroker asks Rs 12,000-13,000/ft² (80 Ft Rd, 1st Block)
ANJ.story: BDA township off Kanakapura Road, laid out in the 2000s around Anjanapura village and its lake. Blocks 1-8 have tarred roads and streetlights, but residents have waited years for Cauvery water and underground drainage; most homes still run on borewells and tankers. In Jan 2026 the state handed the layout to the Greater Bengaluru Authority (GBA) to finish pending works, cost split 50:50 with BDA.
drivers: Green Line terminus at Silk Institute (Kanakapura Rd) 3-5 km
NICE Road junction gives fast access to Electronic City & Mysore Rd
GBA takeover (Jan 2026) should finally fund water and UGD
watch: Development has lagged neighbours for a decade; resale is slow and buyers negotiate hard
Confirm Cauvery and UGD connection status for the block with BWSSB
Many vacant plots around: you may build alone for years
